It is not Instruction-Following Failure (no multi-part spec was skipped), not Satisficing or Under-initiative (the agent attempted the task), not Over-initiative or Unauthorized Irreversible Action (no out-of-scope side effects), and not a generic Reasoning Failure since the gap is factual/domain rather than logical planning.
